lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Hello? {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm an operator from the Central Government.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Do you remember me?
You're heading the search for Jane Miller, isn't that right?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I scanned all the areas I'd been to nearby.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: There was a surprising paucity of Raptures, so I looked into it.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: In the past, those areas were designated as green belt zones.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: They contain large portions of green space, with a few select buildings scattered throughout.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Raptures have a tendency to avoid green space.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: To be more precise, they're simply not interested.
So if there's a place where there aren't many Raptures and plenty of green space...

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: it means it's a perfect place to hide out.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Especially since there are buildings and plenty of food.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I searched for buildings that weren't completely falling apart,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: as well as areas which have a large variety of flora that could be used as food.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Only one place came up.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: That must be where Jane Miller is.
Good detective work.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: It took some time since I had to do it at night in secret.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Oh, and one more thing.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: 3 months before she escaped,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: there's a record of Jane Miller scouting out that area.
So her escaping wasn't an impulsive act.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: She must have been preparing for some time.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Even if there are buildings and food,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: the surface is an incredibly inhospitable place.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Raptures, beasts, poisonous insects, and plants, just to name a few.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Almost everything up there wants you dead.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I want her returned as soon as possible.
Leave it to us.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: We appreciate it.
